title: Dak li ġie Eskluż mit-Test tal-Ilma
intro: Fl-annali tal-iskrittura antika, teżisti figura affaxxinanti li l-istorja tagħha ma tibdax b'miraklu drammatiku jew rivelazzjoni qawwija, iżda bi prova sempliċi iżda profonda tal-fidi. Nazzjon kien f'salib it-toroq, ifittex gwida divina għat-tmexxija. Dak li żvolġa kien test tant intelliġenti li kien se jikxef il-fidili veri fosthom. Tista' tikxef dan il-misteru mill-ħjiel li ħallew warajhom?
clues: Jiena ġejt minn nisel li n-nies kienu jammiraw, u Alla għażilni għal skop sagru li ma setgħux jifhmu.
Ġismi kellu marka ta’ distinzjoni li ħaddieħor ma kellux, u dan ġagħalni nispikka fost niesi.
Meta x-xmara ġiet iddikjarata bħala t-test, il-biċċa l-kbira daru lura—imma jien bqajt sejjer 'il quddiem, immexxi minn fidi soda fil-wegħda t'Alla.
Ġejt ordnat biex qatt ma nixrob minn ilmijiet ipprojbiti, iżda qatra waħda ħarġet minn xofftejja—dnub li baqa’ jturmentali għal qalbi għal dejjem.
Alla ddestinani li niltaqa' ma' ragħaj żagħżugħ li xi darba kellu jsir leġġendarju talli qatel avversarju setgħan.
Meta l-armati ħabtu, ma waqajtx b'id l-għadu, iżda b'digriet divin bħala kastig għad-diżubbidjenza tiegħi ħdejn ix-xmara.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
